svg.text: three layers, each ≤ the one above
reserved — not implemented in this release
Pausing forgets what a collector last held —
not a tier change, a separate narrowing.
layered on the install's own scope, ≤ 200
system namespaces — can never be excluded
A warning next to the field, not a blocked
save — it clears once the agent reports it.
dropAboveTier and dropConsentOverrides strip whatever a sync, flow or measurement
batch shouldn't contain — checked again here, regardless of what the agent actually sent.
The agent applies every narrowing to itself first; this is the server not taking that on faith.
